prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a passenger and reported whiplash. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1140; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left-turn lane at an intersection in Houston, Texas, when the collision occurred. Driver 1 stated that the vehicle was turning left when it was struck by Driver 2's vehicle, which had entered the intersection from the opposite direction. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the applicable policy. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat at the time of the impact and reported neck pain consistent with whiplash. The reported injury appears consistent with the type and force of a broadside impact of this kind. Damage to the vehicle, including the driver-side front quarter panel and door, matches the impact described by the parties. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several of these details. No independent witnesses to the collision were identified. Responding officers and the parties present confirmed that Passenger was inside the vehicle at the time. No prior damage to the vehicle has been reported or observed. Officers have documented the scene and will forward the report for review.
